description: Source code implementing thread-local and final timer management for tracing, including start/stop, update, and emit functions for timers.

methods.name: tr2_start_timer
methods.description: Starts a timer for a given timer ID, handling recursion and recording start time.

methods.name: tr2_stop_timer
methods.description: Stops a timer, updates total, min, max, and interval counts, and manages recursion.

methods.name: tr2_update_final_timers
methods.description: Aggregates thread-local timer data into a final timer block.

methods.name: tr2_emit_per_thread_timers
methods.description: Emits per-thread timer data if applicable.
